'''Redgill Lake''' was a [[lake]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. The [[Raining Leaves Clan]] and [[Broken Columns Clan]] held their annual meeting near this lake. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], their [[Conclave of the Raining Leaves Clan and the Broken Columns Clan|conclave]] near here, although it had to be moved to another nearby location, [[Bright Sun Hill]], due to various attacks by [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]]. The hill was later [[Attack on Bright Sun Hill|attacked]] by Nightsisters, but the Clans managed to defeat their assailants.
